scope.definition: Repository-maintained files read by the MCP application's HTTP or alternative stdio lifecycle, startup, package resolution, configured resources, or Codespaces initialization.
scope.source_of_evidence: Static trace of committed entrypoints, import statements, shell scripts, Codespace configuration, and explicit filesystem read operations; conditional reads are included, not asserted observed in a live request.
scope.excluded: Third-party Node packages, Node and operating-system internals, generated dependency trees, test-only files, and arbitrary files read by user-supplied terminal commands. Referenced documents not actually loaded by the MCP server are excluded.
scope.version_identity: Each file is pinned by SHA-256 of the committed bytes and by the Git blob object ID; the source commit identifies the snapshot from which all entries were computed.
